headline_en: The certified PP 1041/2017 file together with the Insolvency Administrator's internal authority, instruction and estate-interest record.
headline_es: El expediente certificado PP 1041/2017 junto con el expediente interno del Administrador concursal relativo a autoridad, instrucciones y análisis del interés de la masa.
directly_documented: LPB obtained admission of a judicial route seeking the PH122→CAM deed, price, payment and costs.
On 25 January 2018 the Insolvency Administrator terminated the formal mandate of the lawyer pursuing that route and imposed an authorisation gate over later LPB action.
A withdrawal was later filed in LPB's name.
The route ended and was later confirmed archived because of that withdrawal.
por_derecho_formal_allegations: LPB did not validly authorise the withdrawal.
The filing was caused or enabled through the Insolvency Administrator-controlled representation.
Attributing the act to LPB as its voluntary decision was false in substance.
The act deliberately destroyed a route capable of supporting redemption, debt satisfaction and a successful insolvency exit.
The act was conflicted, wholly detrimental to LPB and the estate, and materially beneficial to CAM and the Acosta Matos perimeter.
The act became an enabling bridge within the alleged credit-to-control-to-title economic-offence architecture.
p0_production: native filing, signature and transmission metadata
instruction authorising withdrawal and its author
LPB corporate or competent insolvency authority
Insolvency Administrator written authority and legal basis
communications with CAM, its lawyers and creditor perimeter
internal AC communications and decision records

potential_criminal_relevance: participation, necessary cooperation or commission by omission
corporate benefit and responsibility where statutory elements are met
publication_boundary: Strong formal allegation. The direct procedural acts are documented; authority, false attribution, conflict, purpose, coordination and criminal liability require certified primary production and competent determination.
